verdicts.RBP-F003: closed. OrderedMap rejects duplicate keys, and the response uses RESPONSE_INVALID. JevState::Object is OrderedMap<String, Value>. JevQuestion has one validating constructor for the criteria counts. The nested-Value claim is narrowed to the top level only. test_state_forms_roundtrip uses unsorted keys, and test_duplicate_key_rejected is added.
